node.title: [RE] match positions of named captures?
node.author: LanX
node.doctext:
In continuation of [id://11109433]
  • There is a way to get the pos of capture groups by index via [DOC://@-|@-] and [DOC://@+|@+]
  • There is a way to get capture groups by name via [DOC://%+|%+]
  • But what's the way to get the positions of a named capture?

I googled and could only find this SO discussion [HTTPs://stackoverflow.com/questions/44113809/match-positions-of-named-capture-groups-in-perls-regexps|match-positions-of-named-capture-groups-in-perls-regexps] but poor Felix didn't get a proper answer.

Though I slightly remember we already had this discussion here...

(something like finding the index of a named capture and accessing @+ / @- probably? Hint: [DOC://%-|%-] doesn't help here)

update

I tried to look into [METAMOD://Tie::Hash::NamedCapture] , the "Pragmatic Module" used to implement %+ and %- but stopped at the XS barrier

Cheers Rolf
(addicted to the Perl Programming Language :)
